item.title: Strategic Planning: FDA Could Further Strengthen Robust IT Modernization Plan
item.description:
What GAO Found
The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has developed a suite of strategic planning documentation to guide modernization of its information technology (IT) systems and support the agency’s IT strategic mission. FDA’s strategic plan suite identifies IT strategic goals and captures key upcoming agencywide modernization efforts. FDA’s strategic plans fully address six of eight strategic planning leading practices. For example, the plan aligns to agency and department-wide missions, identifies performance measures for meeting agency IT goals, and defines roles and responsibilities for meeting the goals.
